intent: TEST for IngestTelemetryService at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/intake/application/IngestTelemetryService.java. JUnit 5 + AssertJ (+ Mockito, reactor-test StepVerifier for reactive code); cover every invariant and behavior below, including failure cases, using only the pinned surfaces of collaborators. Unit under test: Telemetry Intake & Validation use case implementing IngestTelemetryUseCase. Constructor IngestTelemetryService(SensorMetricBoundaryPolicy policy, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetrySampleEvent> validatedSamples). Every sample is validated before propagation; each is mapped to TelemetrySampleEvent (status string VALID or VALIDATION_FAILED) and published in packet order with concatMap (TelemetrySampleValidated / TelemetrySampleValidationFailed). Invalid samples are tagged, never dropped. Channel overflow error propagates to the caller (backpressure). No blocking calls.
